WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    member.member_id,
    member.position,
    COUNT(*) as attendance_count
  FROM attendance
  INNER JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
  GROUP BY member.member_id, member.position
)
SELECT
  member_id,
  position,
  attendance_count,
  attendance_count * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () as share
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
